title: Adopt DEVAI in a fresh client repository
summary: A new adopter installs the DEVAI governance harness into an existing client repository, copies the law-pack scaffold, and reaches a first-green spec-validate-all + a first signed RTD manifest.
preconditions: Client repo exists and is a git working tree
Node 24+ and pnpm available on PATH
DEVAI installed as a dev dependency or available via npx

steps.action: Run `devai init plan --target .` and review the Owner, Architect, and F5 bootstrap segments
steps.expected_outcome: A deny-by-default plan is emitted; no repository file is written

steps.action: Apply the three segments through distinct declared invocations: `init apply-owner --as-role owner --write`, `init apply-architect --as-role architect --write`, and `init apply-f5 --introspect --as-role architect --write`; then materialize policy with `adopt upgrade --as-role architect --write`
steps.expected_outcome: Owner and Architect documentation stubs, F5 state/configuration, introspection, and a repository-bound authority policy are created without crossing role boundaries

steps.action: Copy `examples/law-pack/docs/arch/invariants/*.json` and `examples/law-pack/AGENTS.md` into the client repo
steps.expected_outcome: 15 cluster-level invariants present under docs/arch/invariants/; AGENTS.md anchor file present
All five sub-validators pass: invariants, journeys, trace, glossary, action-coverage

steps.action: Run `devai spec rtd bundle --format human` to produce a signed RTM-NNNN manifest
steps.expected_outcome: Manifest persisted under .devai/state/rtd-manifests/; readiness=ok; component hashes emitted

steps.action: Commit the .devai/, docs/arch/, AGENTS.md surfaces; tag adoption complete
steps.expected_outcome: Repo now carries the full DEVAI governance harness; subsequent contributions go through the harness gates
alternative_paths: If an apply segment detects existing targets, refuse with deny-by-default and require --force on that same role-separated segment

postconditions: .devai/config/project.json declares the project_type (runtime-host | platform-package | docs-archive | framework)
spec validate-all is green; rtd bundle produces a stable manifest_hash

acceptance_criteria.statement: After step 5, `devai spec validate all` exits 0 and `devai spec rtd bundle` produces a manifest whose readiness.ok is true.
Every `devai init apply-*` segment is deny-by-default on existing files and does not overwrite without --force; provenance-critical F5 state remains preserved (Article 32).
